name: Thornwick Hollow
summary: A terraced settlement with intact grain pits, first surveyed after erosion exposed a retaining wall. The custodial council restricts exact coordinates while looting risk remains high.

name: Mirelake Causeway
summary: A submerged timber causeway preserved in peat, with carved posts still standing. Waterlogged conditions make the site fragile and easy to damage by unplanned visits.

name: Calder Rise Ossuary
summary: A hillside ossuary holding communal burials that descendant families still consider active. Access is granted case by case, and never to the exact location by default.
